parsed.faithful: It is much convenient to disengage the retorts or bodies while they are still warm, which continues to be the case the next morning after distillation, in consequence of the heat of the sand bath. If they be left to cool entirely, the sulphate of soda will crystallize, and it will be necessary to dissolve in hot water such as will be danger of losing great part of the contents.
